text: {"sql":"SELECT substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
